reason: The user requests both an exchange and an address change on a single order. Policy allows only one of exchange (delivered orders) or modify address (pending orders); these statuses are mutually exclusive, and a given order cannot be both pending and delivered, nor can a delivered order have its shipping address modified. The agent has completed authentication (found yusuf_li_7255 and is looking up details), and the request as stated is partially unfulfillable regardless of order status, likely leading to an unfulfilled request for at least the address change or exchange.
